requirement: Soft delete a suspected cause by id: stamp IsDeleted/DeletedAt, keep its business data and any sibling causes untouched, and report an unknown or already-deleted id as not found.

preconditions.text: A live suspected cause exists for the target id
A sibling cause of the same disease and pathogen exists
The target id matches no live cause, or it is already soft-deleted

inputs.text: Delete request with an unknown id
Delete request for a cause that was soft deleted beforehand
Delete the only cause of the disease and pathogen pair

returns.text: Success with Deleted status; the row is soft-deleted and hidden by the query filter
The business data and sibling causes stay untouched
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Disease cause with this ID not found' error
A rejected delete never moves an existing deletion timestamp

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing or already-deleted cause is returned as a failed Result
